**Derivation**

Let $f(x)=|x+23|+|x-5|+|x-48|$. Solutions of the system correspond to solutions of $f(x)=2x+k$, i.e. $g(x)=k$ where $g(x)=f(x)-2x$.

**Piecewise slopes of $g$** (breakpoints at $-23,\,5,\,48$):

| Interval | Slope of $f$ | Slope of $g=f-2x$ |
|---|---|---|
| $x<-23$ | $-3$ | $-5$ |
| $-23<x<5$ | $-1$ | $-3$ |
| $5<x<48$ | $+1$ | $-1$ |
| $x>48$ | $+3$ | $+1$ |

So $g$ is continuous and strictly decreasing on $(-\infty,48]$ and strictly increasing on $[48,\infty)$. Its unique minimum is at $x=48$.

**Minimum value:** $g(48)=|71|+|43|+|0|-96=114-96=18$.

**Counting solutions of $g(x)=k$:**
- As $x\to\pm\infty$, $g(x)\to+\infty$ (slopes $-5$ on the left and $+1$ on the right).
- For $k<18$: no solutions.
- For $k=18$: exactly one solution, $x=48$, since this is the only point where the minimum is attained.
- For $k>18$: two solutions, one on each monotone branch.

So the system has exactly one real solution only when $k=18$. Check: at $x=48$, $y=2(48)+18=114=f(48)$. ✓

The set of such $k$ is $\{18\}$, so the sum is $18$.

Final answer: 18
